synopsis: DMRE and mines are listed as accepting evidence in the South African trackless mobile machine regulatory case [f1858]. Separately, DMRE data reported via the Minerals Council recorded 49 mining deaths in South Africa in 2022 [f3199]. The transport and mining category accounted for 17 deaths in 2022, compared with 16 in 2021, indicating an increase of one death in that category [f3200]. These facts establish DMRE’s evidence-acceptance role and provide fatality context, but do not specify acceptance criteria or demonstrate that accepted evidence reduced fatalities [f1858, f3199, f3200].

relations.note: Adds category-specific fatalities and a prior-year comparison to the 2022 mining death total.
